svg.text: Home electricity prices by state: change in one year
Average residential price, September 2026 vs. September 2025. Prices rose in 42 of 51 states (incl. D.C.).
Largest rises: HI +22.2%, ID +15.1%, ME +12.2% · Largest falls: CT −10.9%, FL −6.5%, UT −4.4%
Each tile: % change and current price in cents/kWh
Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Electric Power Monthly, Table 5.6.A (September 2026 preliminary). Chart: roofpayback.com
